findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: url_safety_check · Private data: base_tx_explain, base_token_approvals, ethereum_tx_explain, ethereum_token_approvals, bsc_tx_explain, bsc_token_approvals, url_safety_check, ens_resolve, calldata_decode, wallet_portfolio, wallet_report, token_report, token_deep_scan, solana_token_check · Public sink: token_deep_scan, solana_token_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: url_safety_check · Private data: base_tx_explain, base_token_approvals, ethereum_tx_explain, ethereum_token_approvals, bsc_tx_explain, bsc_token_approvals, url_safety_check, ens_resolve, calldata_decode, wallet_portfolio, wallet_report, token_report, token_deep_scan, solana_token_check · Public sink: token_deep_scan, solana_token_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
